verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only generic AI claims and developer building blocks: 'answers with citations', 24/7 agents, Custom Agent APIs, and MCP read/create access. Nothing documents AI drafting a project or initiative status update from recent activity. AI Q&A and API/MCP primitives are adjacent capabilities or building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
